data.summary: This section defines AGV tasks as station-triggered operations and outlines the interface for managing them, including viewing current and archived entries and removing in-progress tasks. It details the specific data fields associated with active and archived tasks, such as trigger time, destination, and final results, while distinguishing between the executable current view and the immutable archive.
